title: Virtual input symbol at a segment position
statement: Let $\mathrm{segs}$ be a list of segments, let $s<|\mathrm{segs}|$, and let $tp$ be a valid virtual position in segment $s$. For any configuration whose input is the virtual word formed from these segments, if its input-head position is the virtual offset corresponding to $tp$, then the symbol under the input head equals the virtual symbol specified by $tp$ in segment $s$.
hypotheses_covered: The configuration input is the virtual word formed from $\mathrm{segs}$
The input-head position equals the virtual position corresponding to $tp$
